--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import { pavolTestimonials as PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-testimonials';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
+export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    return (
+        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
+                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
+                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
+                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
+                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
+                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
+                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
+                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
+                                    <Image
+                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
+                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
+                                        width={48}
+                                        height={48}
+                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
+                                    />
+                                )}
+                                <div>
+                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
+                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
+                                </div>
+                            </figcaption>
+                        </figure>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
index f716bba415392187784eb1c7439780b0f155cc7b..346bfa4bf6a73e924b92062bb562458c8aa4c369
--- a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
+++ b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
@@ -1,8 +1,250 @@
+.pavol-site {
+    color-scheme: light;
+    --pavol-section-space: clamp(4rem, 7vw, 6.5rem);
+}
+
+.pavol-site ::selection {
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-header {
+    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pavol-paper) 94%, transparent);
+}
+
+.pavol-section {
+    padding-block: var(--pavol-section-space);
+}
+
+.pavol-eyebrow {
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.75rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-accent);
+    font-size: 0.6875rem;
+    font-weight: 600;
+    line-height: 1.7;
+    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
+    text-transform: uppercase;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-title {
+    text-wrap: balance;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-description {
+    color: var(--pavol-muted);
+}
+
+.pavol-hero-name {
+    font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.4vw, 6.5rem);
+    line-height: 1.04;
+    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame {
+    position: relative;
+    isolation: isolate;
+    overflow: hidden;
+    aspect-ratio: 0.93;
+    border-radius: 1.25rem 8rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;
+    background: #e6e8dd;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame::after {
+    position: absolute;
+    inset: 1.25rem;
+    z-index: -1;
+    border: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 12%);
+    border-radius: 0.25rem 6.75rem 0.25rem 0.25rem;
+    content: '';
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-disc {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 10%;
+    left: 4%;
+    width: 92%;
+    aspect-ratio: 1;
+    border-radius: 50%;
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-image {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 5%;
+    left: 7%;
+    width: 86%;
+    height: auto;
+    max-width: none;
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button {
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    color: white;
+    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(32 57 50 / 8%);
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button:hover {
+    background: var(--pavol-accent);
+}
+
+.pavol-numbers > div {
+    padding-inline: 1.25rem;
+    border-left: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 15%);
+}
+
+.pavol-numbers > div:nth-child(odd) {
+    padding-left: 0;
+    border-left: 0;
+}
+
+.pavol-service {
+    background: var(--pavol-paper);
+    border: 1px solid var(--pavol-warm);
+}
+
+.pavol-service:nth-child(even) {
+    background: #f0f4ef;
+    border-color: #e4ebe2;
+}
+
+.pavol-link-arrow {
+    display: inline-flex;
+    flex-shrink: 0;
+    align-items: center;
+    justify-content: center;
+    width: 2.75rem;
+    height: 2.75rem;
+    border: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 20%);
+    border-radius: 50%;
+    transition: background 180ms, color 180ms, transform 180ms;
+}
+
+.group:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .pavol-link-arrow {
+    color: white;
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    transform: rotate(45deg);
+}
+
+.pavol-projects .pavol-eyebrow {
+    color: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-projects .pavol-section-description,
+.pavol-project-description {
+    color: #c4d0c6;
+}
+
+.pavol-project {
+    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 3%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-number {
+    color: #c4d0c6;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured {
+    min-height: 26rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+    border-color: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured h3 {
+    margin-top: auto;
+    padding-top: 5rem;
+    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
+    line-height: 1.1;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-description {
+    max-width: 24rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-number {
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-mark {
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-watermark {
+    opacity: 0.07;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-link {
+    border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-link:hover {
+    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-link {
+    color: white;
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    border-color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-link:hover {
+    background: var(--pavol-accent);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured > div:last-child {
+    margin-top: 0;
+}
+
+.pavol-testimonial {
+    padding-block: 1.5rem 0.5rem;
+    border-top: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 20%);
+}
+
+.pavol-testimonial:first-child {
+    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
+    border: 0;
+    border-radius: 1rem;
+    background: #e9eee5;
+}
+
+.pavol-testimonial:first-child blockquote {
+    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
+    font-size: 1.5rem;
+    line-height: 1.5;
+    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
+}
+
+.pavol-contact-form {
+    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgb(32 57 50 / 5%);
+}
+
+.pavol-contact-form :is(input, select, textarea) {
+    border-color: #d8dfd7;
+    border-radius: 0.625rem;
+    background: #fdfdfb;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-contact-form :is(input, textarea)::placeholder {
+    color: var(--pavol-muted);

+import { pavolNumbers as PAVOL_NUMBERS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-numbers';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+
+export function PavolNumbersSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].numbers;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="numbers" tabIndex={-1} className="pb-16 outline-none sm:pb-24">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/20 pt-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-10">
+                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium tracking-tight">{CONTENT.title}</h2>
+                    <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{CONTENT.description}</p>
+                </div>
+                <dl className="pavol-numbers mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-8 lg:grid-cols-4">
+                    {PAVOL_NUMBERS[language].map((ITEM) => (
+                        <div key={ITEM.label} className="flex flex-col">
+                            <dt className="mt-3 max-w-[15rem] text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)] sm:text-sm">
+                                {ITEM.label}
+                            </dt>
+                            <dd className="order-first font-[family-name:var(--font-outfit)] text-5xl font-medium tracking-[-0.05em] text-[var(--pavol-accent)] sm:text-6xl">
+                                {ITEM.value}
+                            </dd>
+                        </div>
+                    ))}
+                </dl>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..117a4fbf0cb362a4be2658dfbfa8a33a34867511
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { PavolContactForm } from '@/businesses/pavol/usePavolContactForm';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { ArrowUpRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
+
+export function PavolServicesSection({
+    language,
+    form,
+}: {
+    readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage;
+    readonly form: PavolContactForm;
+}) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].services;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="services" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section bg-white outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...CONTENT} />
+                <div className="mt-12 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-8">
+                    {CONTENT.items.map((SERVICE, index) => (
+                        <article key={SERVICE.id} className="pavol-service flex flex-col rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-9">
+                            <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex items-center justify-between">
+                                <span className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--pavol-accent)]/20 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]">
+                                    <SERVICE.icon className="h-6 w-6" strokeWidth={1.5} />
+                                </span>
+                                <span className="font-mono text-sm text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">0{index + 1}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <h3 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight sm:text-[2.25rem]">
+                                {SERVICE.title}
+                            </h3>
+                            <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">
+                                {SERVICE.description}
+                            </p>
+                            <ul className="mb-8 mt-6 space-y-3 text-sm text-[var(--pavol-ink)]">
+                                {SERVICE.topics.map((TOPIC) => (
+                                    <li key={TOPIC} className="flex gap-3">
+                                        <Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" />
+                                        {TOPIC}
+                                    </li>
+                                ))}
+                            </ul>
+                            <a
+                                href="#contact"
+                                aria-disabled={form.isSubmitting}
+                                onClick={(event) => {
+                                    if (form.isSubmitting) {
+                                        event.preventDefault();
+                                        return;
+                                    }
+                                    form.selectService(SERVICE.id);
+                                }}
+                                className="group mt-auto inline-flex min-h-14 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/15 pt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--pavol-ink)] aria-disabled:opacity-50"
+                            >
+                                {SERVICE.buttonLabel}
+                                <span className="pavol-link-arrow">
+                                    <ArrowUpRight aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5" />
+                                </span>
+                            </a>
+                        </article>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import { pavolTestimonials as PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-testimonials';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
+export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    return (
+        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
+                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
+                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
+                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
+                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
+                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
+                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
+                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
+                                    <Image
+                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
+                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
+                                        width={48}
+                                        height={48}
+                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
+                                    />
+                                )}
+                                <div>
+                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
+                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
+                                </div>
+                            </figcaption>
+                        </figure>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
index f716bba415392187784eb1c7439780b0f155cc7b..346bfa4bf6a73e924b92062bb562458c8aa4c369
--- a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
+++ b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
@@ -1,8 +1,250 @@
+.pavol-site {
+    color-scheme: light;
+    --pavol-section-space: clamp(4rem, 7vw, 6.5rem);
+}
+
+.pavol-site ::selection {
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-header {
+    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pavol-paper) 94%, transparent);
+}
+
+.pavol-section {
+    padding-block: var(--pavol-section-space);
+}
+
+.pavol-eyebrow {
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.75rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-accent);
+    font-size: 0.6875rem;
+    font-weight: 600;
+    line-height: 1.7;
+    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
+    text-transform: uppercase;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-title {
+    text-wrap: balance;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-description {
+    color: var(--pavol-muted);
+}
+
+.pavol-hero-name {
+    font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.4vw, 6.5rem);
+    line-height: 1.04;
+    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame {
+    position: relative;
+    isolation: isolate;
+    overflow: hidden;
+    aspect-ratio: 0.93;
+    border-radius: 1.25rem 8rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;
+    background: #e6e8dd;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame::after {
+    position: absolute;
+    inset: 1.25rem;
+    z-index: -1;
+    border: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 12%);
+    border-radius: 0.25rem 6.75rem 0.25rem 0.25rem;
+    content: '';
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-disc {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 10%;
+    left: 4%;
+    width: 92%;
+    aspect-ratio: 1;
+    border-radius: 50%;
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-image {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 5%;
+    left: 7%;
+    width: 86%;
+    height: auto;
+    max-width: none;
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button {
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    color: white;
+    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(32 57 50 / 8%);
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button:hover {
+    background: var(--pavol-accent);
+}
+
+.pavol-numbers > div {
+    padding-inline: 1.25rem;
+    border-left: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 15%);
+}
+
+.pavol-numbers > div:nth-child(odd) {
+    padding-left: 0;
+    border-left: 0;
+}
+
+.pavol-service {
+    background: var(--pavol-paper);
+    border: 1px solid var(--pavol-warm);
+}
+
+.pavol-service:nth-child(even) {
+    background: #f0f4ef;
+    border-color: #e4ebe2;
+}
+
+.pavol-link-arrow {
+    display: inline-flex;
+    flex-shrink: 0;
+    align-items: center;
+    justify-content: center;
+    width: 2.75rem;
+    height: 2.75rem;
+    border: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 20%);
+    border-radius: 50%;
+    transition: background 180ms, color 180ms, transform 180ms;
+}
+
+.group:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .pavol-link-arrow {
+    color: white;
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    transform: rotate(45deg);
+}
+
+.pavol-projects .pavol-eyebrow {
+    color: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-projects .pavol-section-description,
+.pavol-project-description {
+    color: #c4d0c6;
+}
+
+.pavol-project {
+    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 3%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-number {
+    color: #c4d0c6;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured {
+    min-height: 26rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+    border-color: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured h3 {
+    margin-top: auto;
+    padding-top: 5rem;
+    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
+    line-height: 1.1;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-description {
+    max-width: 24rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-number {
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-mark {
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-watermark {
+    opacity: 0.07;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-link {
+    border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-link:hover {
+    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-link {
+    color: white;
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    border-color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-link:hover {
+    background: var(--pavol-accent);
+}
+

+import { pavolNumbers as PAVOL_NUMBERS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-numbers';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+
+export function PavolNumbersSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].numbers;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="numbers" tabIndex={-1} className="pb-16 outline-none sm:pb-24">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/20 pt-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-10">
+                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium tracking-tight">{CONTENT.title}</h2>
+                    <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{CONTENT.description}</p>
+                </div>
+                <dl className="pavol-numbers mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-8 lg:grid-cols-4">
+                    {PAVOL_NUMBERS[language].map((ITEM) => (
+                        <div key={ITEM.label} className="flex flex-col">
+                            <dt className="mt-3 max-w-[15rem] text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)] sm:text-sm">
+                                {ITEM.label}
+                            </dt>
+                            <dd className="order-first font-[family-name:var(--font-outfit)] text-5xl font-medium tracking-[-0.05em] text-[var(--pavol-accent)] sm:text-6xl">
+                                {ITEM.value}
+                            </dd>
+                        </div>
+                    ))}
+                </dl>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..117a4fbf0cb362a4be2658dfbfa8a33a34867511
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { PavolContactForm } from '@/businesses/pavol/usePavolContactForm';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { ArrowUpRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
+
+export function PavolServicesSection({
+    language,
+    form,
+}: {
+    readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage;
+    readonly form: PavolContactForm;
+}) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].services;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="services" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section bg-white outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...CONTENT} />
+                <div className="mt-12 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-8">
+                    {CONTENT.items.map((SERVICE, index) => (
+                        <article key={SERVICE.id} className="pavol-service flex flex-col rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-9">
+                            <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex items-center justify-between">
+                                <span className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--pavol-accent)]/20 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]">
+                                    <SERVICE.icon className="h-6 w-6" strokeWidth={1.5} />
+                                </span>
+                                <span className="font-mono text-sm text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">0{index + 1}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <h3 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight sm:text-[2.25rem]">
+                                {SERVICE.title}
+                            </h3>
+                            <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">
+                                {SERVICE.description}
+                            </p>
+                            <ul className="mb-8 mt-6 space-y-3 text-sm text-[var(--pavol-ink)]">
+                                {SERVICE.topics.map((TOPIC) => (
+                                    <li key={TOPIC} className="flex gap-3">
+                                        <Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" />
+                                        {TOPIC}
+                                    </li>
+                                ))}
+                            </ul>
+                            <a
+                                href="#contact"
+                                aria-disabled={form.isSubmitting}
+                                onClick={(event) => {
+                                    if (form.isSubmitting) {
+                                        event.preventDefault();
+                                        return;
+                                    }
+                                    form.selectService(SERVICE.id);
+                                }}
+                                className="group mt-auto inline-flex min-h-14 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/15 pt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--pavol-ink)] aria-disabled:opacity-50"
+                            >
+                                {SERVICE.buttonLabel}
+                                <span className="pavol-link-arrow">
+                                    <ArrowUpRight aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5" />
+                                </span>
+                            </a>
+                        </article>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import { pavolTestimonials as PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-testimonials';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
+export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    return (
+        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
+                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
+                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
+                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
+                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
+                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
+                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
+                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
+                                    <Image
+                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
+                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
+                                        width={48}
+                                        height={48}
+                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
+                                    />
+                                )}
+                                <div>
+                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
+                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
+                                </div>
+                            </figcaption>
+                        </figure>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
index f716bba415392187784eb1c7439780b0f155cc7b..346bfa4bf6a73e924b92062bb562458c8aa4c369
--- a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
+++ b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
@@ -1,8 +1,250 @@
+.pavol-site {
+    color-scheme: light;
+    --pavol-section-space: clamp(4rem, 7vw, 6.5rem);
+}
+
+.pavol-site ::selection {
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-header {
+    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pavol-paper) 94%, transparent);
+}
+
+.pavol-section {
+    padding-block: var(--pavol-section-space);
+}
+
+.pavol-eyebrow {
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.75rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-accent);
+    font-size: 0.6875rem;
+    font-weight: 600;
+    line-height: 1.7;
+    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
+    text-transform: uppercase;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-title {
+    text-wrap: balance;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-description {
+    color: var(--pavol-muted);
+}
+
+.pavol-hero-name {
+    font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.4vw, 6.5rem);
+    line-height: 1.04;
+    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame {
+    position: relative;
+    isolation: isolate;
+    overflow: hidden;
+    aspect-ratio: 0.93;
+    border-radius: 1.25rem 8rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;
+    background: #e6e8dd;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame::after {
+    position: absolute;
+    inset: 1.25rem;
+    z-index: -1;
+    border: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 12%);
+    border-radius: 0.25rem 6.75rem 0.25rem 0.25rem;
+    content: '';
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-disc {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 10%;
+    left: 4%;
+    width: 92%;
+    aspect-ratio: 1;
+    border-radius: 50%;
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-image {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 5%;
+    left: 7%;
+    width: 86%;
+    height: auto;
+    max-width: none;
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button {
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    color: white;
+    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(32 57 50 / 8%);
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button:hover {
+    background: var(--pavol-accent);
+}
+
+.pavol-numbers > div {
+    padding-inline: 1.25rem;
+    border-left: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 15%);
+}
+
+.pavol-numbers > div:nth-child(odd) {
+    padding-left: 0;
+    border-left: 0;
+}
+
+.pavol-service {
+    background: var(--pavol-paper);
+    border: 1px solid var(--pavol-warm);
+}
+
+.pavol-service:nth-child(even) {
+    background: #f0f4ef;
+    border-color: #e4ebe2;
+}
+
+.pavol-link-arrow {
+    display: inline-flex;
+    flex-shrink: 0;
+    align-items: center;
+    justify-content: center;
+    width: 2.75rem;
+    height: 2.75rem;
+    border: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 20%);
+    border-radius: 50%;
+    transition: background 180ms, color 180ms, transform 180ms;
+}
+
+.group:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .pavol-link-arrow {
+    color: white;
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    transform: rotate(45deg);
+}
+
+.pavol-projects .pavol-eyebrow {
+    color: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-projects .pavol-section-description,
+.pavol-project-description {
+    color: #c4d0c6;
+}
+
+.pavol-project {
+    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 3%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-number {
+    color: #c4d0c6;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured {
+    min-height: 26rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+    border-color: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured h3 {
+    margin-top: auto;
+    padding-top: 5rem;
+    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
+    line-height: 1.1;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-description {
+    max-width: 24rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-number {
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-mark {
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-watermark {
+    opacity: 0.07;
+}
+
+.pavol-project-link {
+    border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-link:hover {
+    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-link {
+    color: white;
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    border-color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured .pavol-project-link:hover {
+    background: var(--pavol-accent);
+}
+
+.pavol-project-featured > div:last-child {
+    margin-top: 0;
+}
+
+.pavol-testimonial {
+    padding-block: 1.5rem 0.5rem;
+    border-top: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 20%);
+}
+
+.pavol-testimonial:first-child {
+    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
+    border: 0;
+    border-radius: 1rem;
+    background: #e9eee5;
+}
+
+.pavol-testimonial:first-child blockquote {
+    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
+    font-size: 1.5rem;
+    line-height: 1.5;
+    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
+}
+
+.pavol-contact-form {
+    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgb(32 57 50 / 5%);
+}
+
+.pavol-contact-form :is(input, select, textarea) {
+    border-color: #d8dfd7;
+    border-radius: 0.625rem;
+    background: #fdfdfb;
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+}
+
+.pavol-contact-form :is(input, textarea)::placeholder {
+    color: var(--pavol-muted);
+}
+
 .pavol-site :is(a, button, input, textarea, select, summary):focus-visible {

+

+}
+
 .pavol-site :is(main, section) {

 }

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { pavolNumbers as PAVOL_NUMBERS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-numbers';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+
+export function PavolNumbersSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].numbers;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="numbers" tabIndex={-1} className="pb-16 outline-none sm:pb-24">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/20 pt-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-10">
+                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium tracking-tight">{CONTENT.title}</h2>
+                    <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{CONTENT.description}</p>
+                </div>
+                <dl className="pavol-numbers mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-8 lg:grid-cols-4">
+                    {PAVOL_NUMBERS[language].map((ITEM) => (
+                        <div key={ITEM.label} className="flex flex-col">
+                            <dt className="mt-3 max-w-[15rem] text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)] sm:text-sm">
+                                {ITEM.label}
+                            </dt>
+                            <dd className="order-first font-[family-name:var(--font-outfit)] text-5xl font-medium tracking-[-0.05em] text-[var(--pavol-accent)] sm:text-6xl">
+                                {ITEM.value}
+                            </dd>
+                        </div>
+                    ))}
+                </dl>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..117a4fbf0cb362a4be2658dfbfa8a33a34867511
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { PavolContactForm } from '@/businesses/pavol/usePavolContactForm';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { ArrowUpRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
+
+export function PavolServicesSection({
+    language,
+    form,
+}: {
+    readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage;
+    readonly form: PavolContactForm;
+}) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].services;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="services" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section bg-white outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...CONTENT} />
+                <div className="mt-12 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-8">
+                    {CONTENT.items.map((SERVICE, index) => (
+                        <article key={SERVICE.id} className="pavol-service flex flex-col rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-9">
+                            <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex items-center justify-between">
+                                <span className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--pavol-accent)]/20 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]">
+                                    <SERVICE.icon className="h-6 w-6" strokeWidth={1.5} />
+                                </span>
+                                <span className="font-mono text-sm text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">0{index + 1}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <h3 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight sm:text-[2.25rem]">
+                                {SERVICE.title}
+                            </h3>
+                            <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">
+                                {SERVICE.description}
+                            </p>
+                            <ul className="mb-8 mt-6 space-y-3 text-sm text-[var(--pavol-ink)]">
+                                {SERVICE.topics.map((TOPIC) => (
+                                    <li key={TOPIC} className="flex gap-3">
+                                        <Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" />
+                                        {TOPIC}
+                                    </li>
+                                ))}
+                            </ul>
+                            <a
+                                href="#contact"
+                                aria-disabled={form.isSubmitting}
+                                onClick={(event) => {
+                                    if (form.isSubmitting) {
+                                        event.preventDefault();
+                                        return;
+                                    }
+                                    form.selectService(SERVICE.id);
+                                }}
+                                className="group mt-auto inline-flex min-h-14 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/15 pt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--pavol-ink)] aria-disabled:opacity-50"
+                            >
+                                {SERVICE.buttonLabel}
+                                <span className="pavol-link-arrow">
+                                    <ArrowUpRight aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5" />
+                                </span>
+                            </a>
+                        </article>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

+import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
+export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    return (
+        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
+                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
+                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
+                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
+                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
+                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
+                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
+                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
+                                    <Image
+                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
+                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
+                                        width={48}
+                                        height={48}
+                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
+                                    />
+                                )}
+                                <div>
+                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
+                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
+                                </div>
+                            </figcaption>
+                        </figure>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

+.pavol-site {

+}
+

+    line-height: 1.7;

+

+

+
+.pavol-primary-button {

+}

+}
+
+.group:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .pavol-link-arrow {

+}

+.pavol-contact-form :is(input, select, textarea) {

+}
+
+.pavol-contact-form :is(input, textarea)::placeholder {
+    color: var(--pavol-muted);
+}
+
 .pavol-site :is(a, button, input, textarea, select, summary):focus-visible {

+.pavol-projects :is(a, button):focus-visible,

+import { pavolNumbers as PAVOL_NUMBERS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-numbers';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+
+export function PavolNumbersSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].numbers;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="numbers" tabIndex={-1} className="pb-16 outline-none sm:pb-24">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/20 pt-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-10">
+                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium tracking-tight">{CONTENT.title}</h2>
+                    <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{CONTENT.description}</p>
+                </div>
+                <dl className="pavol-numbers mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-8 lg:grid-cols-4">
+                    {PAVOL_NUMBERS[language].map((ITEM) => (
+                        <div key={ITEM.label} className="flex flex-col">
+                            <dt className="mt-3 max-w-[15rem] text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)] sm:text-sm">
+                                {ITEM.label}
+                            </dt>
+                            <dd className="order-first font-[family-name:var(--font-outfit)] text-5xl font-medium tracking-[-0.05em] text-[var(--pavol-accent)] sm:text-6xl">
+                                {ITEM.value}
+                            </dd>
+                        </div>
+                    ))}
+                </dl>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

+                        <article key={SERVICE.id} className="pavol-service flex flex-col rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-9">
+                            <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex items-center justify-between">
+                                <span className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--pavol-accent)]/20 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]">
+                                    <SERVICE.icon className="h-6 w-6" strokeWidth={1.5} />
+                                </span>
+                                <span className="font-mono text-sm text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">0{index + 1}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <h3 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight sm:text-[2.25rem]">
+                                {SERVICE.title}
+                            </h3>
+                            <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">
+                                {SERVICE.description}
+                            </p>
+                            <ul className="mb-8 mt-6 space-y-3 text-sm text-[var(--pavol-ink)]">
+                                {SERVICE.topics.map((TOPIC) => (
+                                    <li key={TOPIC} className="flex gap-3">
+                                        <Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" />
+                                        {TOPIC}
+                                    </li>
+                                ))}
+                            </ul>
+                            <a
+                                href="#contact"
+                                aria-disabled={form.isSubmitting}
+                                onClick={(event) => {
+                                    if (form.isSubmitting) {

+                                    }
+                                    form.selectService(SERVICE.id);

+                                className="group mt-auto inline-flex min-h-14 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/15 pt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--pavol-ink)] aria-disabled:opacity-50"
+                            >
+                                {SERVICE.buttonLabel}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx b/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..94e30e9e31b85705e9d947afbe489fe89db76184
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import { pavolTestimonials as PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-testimonials';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
+export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    return (
+        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
+                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
+                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
+                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
+                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
+                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
+                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
+                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
+                                    <Image
+                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
+                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
+                                        width={48}
+                                        height={48}
+                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
+                                    />
+                                )}
+                                <div>
+                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
+                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
+                                </div>
+                            </figcaption>
+                        </figure>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..1a66a0beea92bf3d173e383a12da5c8d63fe64a1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolNumbersSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { pavolNumbers as PAVOL_NUMBERS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-numbers';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+
+export function PavolNumbersSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].numbers;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="numbers" tabIndex={-1} className="pb-16 outline-none sm:pb-24">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/20 pt-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-10">
+                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium tracking-tight">{CONTENT.title}</h2>
+                    <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{CONTENT.description}</p>
+                </div>
+                <dl className="pavol-numbers mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-8 lg:grid-cols-4">
+                    {PAVOL_NUMBERS[language].map((ITEM) => (
+                        <div key={ITEM.label} className="flex flex-col">
+                            <dt className="mt-3 max-w-[15rem] text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)] sm:text-sm">
+                                {ITEM.label}
+                            </dt>
+                            <dd className="order-first font-[family-name:var(--font-outfit)] text-5xl font-medium tracking-[-0.05em] text-[var(--pavol-accent)] sm:text-6xl">
+                                {ITEM.value}
+                            </dd>
+                        </div>
+                    ))}
+                </dl>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..117a4fbf0cb362a4be2658dfbfa8a33a34867511
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { PavolContactForm } from '@/businesses/pavol/usePavolContactForm';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { ArrowUpRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
+
+export function PavolServicesSection({
+    language,
+    form,
+}: {
+    readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage;
+    readonly form: PavolContactForm;
+}) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].services;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="services" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section bg-white outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...CONTENT} />
+                <div className="mt-12 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-8">
+                    {CONTENT.items.map((SERVICE, index) => (
+                        <article key={SERVICE.id} className="pavol-service flex flex-col rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-9">
+                            <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex items-center justify-between">
+                                <span className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--pavol-accent)]/20 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]">
+                                    <SERVICE.icon className="h-6 w-6" strokeWidth={1.5} />
+                                </span>
+                                <span className="font-mono text-sm text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">0{index + 1}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <h3 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight sm:text-[2.25rem]">
+                                {SERVICE.title}
+                            </h3>
+                            <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">
+                                {SERVICE.description}
+                            </p>
+                            <ul className="mb-8 mt-6 space-y-3 text-sm text-[var(--pavol-ink)]">
+                                {SERVICE.topics.map((TOPIC) => (
+                                    <li key={TOPIC} className="flex gap-3">
+                                        <Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" />
+                                        {TOPIC}
+                                    </li>
+                                ))}
+                            </ul>
+                            <a
+                                href="#contact"
+                                aria-disabled={form.isSubmitting}
+                                onClick={(event) => {
+                                    if (form.isSubmitting) {
+                                        event.preventDefault();
+                                        return;
+                                    }
+                                    form.selectService(SERVICE.id);
+                                }}
+                                className="group mt-auto inline-flex min-h-14 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/15 pt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--pavol-ink)] aria-disabled:opacity-50"
+                            >
+                                {SERVICE.buttonLabel}
+                                <span className="pavol-link-arrow">
+                                    <ArrowUpRight aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5" />
+                                </span>
+                            </a>
+                        </article>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}
diff --git a/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx b/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..94e30e9e31b85705e9d947afbe489fe89db76184
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import { pavolTestimonials as PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-testimonials';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
+export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    return (
+        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
+                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
+                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
+                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
+                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
+                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
+                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
+                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
+                                    <Image
+                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
+                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
+                                        width={48}
+                                        height={48}
+                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
+                                    />
+                                )}
+                                <div>
+                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
+                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
+                                </div>
+                            </figcaption>
+                        </figure>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

import { pavolProjects as PAVOL_PROJECTS, type PavolProject } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-projects';
import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import Image from 'next/image';

function ProjectMark({ project }: { readonly project: PavolProject }) {
    return (
        <div
            aria-hidden="true"
            className={cn(
                'pavol-project-mark flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 text-white',
                project.logoFrameClassName,
            )}
        >
            {project.logos?.map((LOGO) => (
                <Image
                    key={LOGO.src}
                    src={LOGO.src}
                    alt=""
                    width={36}
                    height={36}
                    className={cn('h-8 w-8 object-contain brightness-0 invert', LOGO.className)}
                />
            ))}
            {project.logoText && <span className="text-lg font-black">{project.logoText}</span>}
            {!project.logos?.length && !project.logoText && project.icon && <project.icon className="h-7 w-7" />}
        </div>
    );
}

export function PavolProjectsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].projects;
    return (
        <section id="projects" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-projects pavol-section bg-[var(--pavol-ink)] text-[var(--pavol-paper)] outline-none">
            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
                <PavolSectionHeading {...CONTENT} />
                <div className="pavol-project-grid mt-12 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                    {PAVOL_PROJECTS[language].map((PROJECT, index) => {
                        const IS_FEATURED = index === 0;
                        return (
                            <article
                                key={PROJECT.title}
                                className={cn(
                                    'pavol-project relative isolate flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/15 p-6 sm:p-8',
                                    IS_FEATURED && 'pavol-project-featured',
                                )}
                            >
                                {IS_FEATURED && PROJECT.logos?.[0] && (
                                    <Image
                                        src={PROJECT.logos[0].src}
                                        alt=""
                                        aria-hidden="true"
                                        width={280}
                                        height={280}
                                        className="pavol-project-watermark pointer-events-none absolute -right-8 top-10 -z-10 h-64 w-64 object-contain brightness-0"
                                    />
                                )}
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                                    <ProjectMark project={PROJECT} />
                                    <span
                                        aria-hidden="true"
                                        className="pavol-project-number font-mono text-sm"
                                    >
                                        0{index + 1}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <h3 className="mt-6 text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight">
                                    {PROJECT.title}
                                </h3>
                                <p
                                    className="pavol-project-description mb-7 mt-3 max-w-lg text-sm leading-relaxed sm:text-base"
                                >
                                    {PROJECT.description}
                                </p>
                                <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                                    {PROJECT.links.map((LINK) => (
                                        <a
                                            key={LINK.href}
                                            href={LINK.href}
                                            className="pavol-project-link inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-5 rounded-full border px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
                                        >
                                            {LINK.label}
                                            {LINK.icon && <LINK.icon aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />}
                                        </a>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            </article>
                        );
                    })}
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}
import { pavolTestimonials as PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-testimonials';
import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';

/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
    return (
        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
                                    <Image
                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
                                        width={48}
                                        height={48}
                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
                                    />
                                )}
                                <div>
                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
                                </div>
                            </figcaption>
                        </figure>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { pavolNumbers as PAVOL_NUMBERS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-numbers';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+
+export function PavolNumbersSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].numbers;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="numbers" tabIndex={-1} className="pb-16 outline-none sm:pb-24">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/20 pt-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-10">
+                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium tracking-tight">{CONTENT.title}</h2>
+                    <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{CONTENT.description}</p>
+                </div>
+                <dl className="pavol-numbers mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-8 lg:grid-cols-4">
+                    {PAVOL_NUMBERS[language].map((ITEM) => (
+                        <div key={ITEM.label} className="flex flex-col">
+                            <dt className="mt-3 max-w-[15rem] text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)] sm:text-sm">
+                                {ITEM.label}
+                            </dt>
+                            <dd className="order-first font-[family-name:var(--font-outfit)] text-5xl font-medium tracking-[-0.05em] text-[var(--pavol-accent)] sm:text-6xl">
+                                {ITEM.value}
+                            </dd>
+                        </div>
+                    ))}
+                </dl>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..117a4fbf0cb362a4be2658dfbfa8a33a34867511
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolServicesSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { PavolContactForm } from '@/businesses/pavol/usePavolContactForm';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { ArrowUpRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
+
+export function PavolServicesSection({
+    language,
+    form,
+}: {
+    readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage;
+    readonly form: PavolContactForm;
+}) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].services;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="services" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section bg-white outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...CONTENT} />
+                <div className="mt-12 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-8">
+                    {CONTENT.items.map((SERVICE, index) => (
+                        <article key={SERVICE.id} className="pavol-service flex flex-col rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-9">
+                            <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex items-center justify-between">
+                                <span className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--pavol-accent)]/20 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]">
+                                    <SERVICE.icon className="h-6 w-6" strokeWidth={1.5} />
+                                </span>
+                                <span className="font-mono text-sm text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">0{index + 1}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <h3 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight sm:text-[2.25rem]">
+                                {SERVICE.title}
+                            </h3>
+                            <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">
+                                {SERVICE.description}
+                            </p>
+                            <ul className="mb-8 mt-6 space-y-3 text-sm text-[var(--pavol-ink)]">
+                                {SERVICE.topics.map((TOPIC) => (
+                                    <li key={TOPIC} className="flex gap-3">
+                                        <Check aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" />
+                                        {TOPIC}
+                                    </li>
+                                ))}
+                            </ul>
+                            <a
+                                href="#contact"
+                                aria-disabled={form.isSubmitting}
+                                onClick={(event) => {
+                                    if (form.isSubmitting) {
+                                        event.preventDefault();
+                                        return;
+                                    }
+                                    form.selectService(SERVICE.id);
+                                }}
+                                className="group mt-auto inline-flex min-h-14 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/15 pt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--pavol-ink)] aria-disabled:opacity-50"
+                            >
+                                {SERVICE.buttonLabel}
+                                <span className="pavol-link-arrow">
+                                    <ArrowUpRight aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5" />
+                                </span>
+                            </a>
+                        </article>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..94e30e9e31b85705e9d947afbe489fe89db76184
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/pavol/PavolTestimonialsSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import { pavolTestimonials as PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-testimonials';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import { PavolSectionHeading } from '@/businesses/pavol/PavolSectionHeading';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+import { Quote } from 'lucide-react';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+/** A static quote layout keeps every reference readable before JavaScript loads. */
+export function PavolTestimonialsSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    return (
+        <section id="testimonials" tabIndex={-1} className="pavol-section outline-none">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <PavolSectionHeading {...PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].testimonials} />
+                <div className="pavol-testimonials mt-12 grid gap-7 md:grid-cols-2">
+                    {PAVOL_TESTIMONIALS[language].map((TESTIMONIAL, index) => (
+                        <figure key={TESTIMONIAL.name} className="pavol-testimonial flex flex-col">
+                            {index === 0 && <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="mb-6 h-9 w-9 text-[var(--pavol-accent)]" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
+                            <blockquote className="mb-7 text-base leading-relaxed">{TESTIMONIAL.testimonial}</blockquote>
+                            <figcaption className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">
+                                {TESTIMONIAL.avatar && (
+                                    <Image
+                                        src={TESTIMONIAL.avatar}
+                                        alt={TESTIMONIAL.name}
+                                        width={48}
+                                        height={48}
+                                        className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[var(--pavol-warm)] object-cover"
+                                    />
+                                )}
+                                <div>
+                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{TESTIMONIAL.name}</p>
+                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{TESTIMONIAL.role}</p>
+                                </div>
+                            </figcaption>
+                        </figure>
+                    ))}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
index f716bba415392187784eb1c7439780b0f155cc7b..346bfa4bf6a73e924b92062bb562458c8aa4c369
--- a/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
+++ b/businesses/pavol/pavol.css
@@ -1,8 +1,250 @@
+.pavol-site {
+    color-scheme: light;
+    --pavol-section-space: clamp(4rem, 7vw, 6.5rem);
+}
+
+.pavol-site ::selection {
+    color: var(--pavol-ink);
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-header {
+    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pavol-paper) 94%, transparent);
+}
+
+.pavol-section {
+    padding-block: var(--pavol-section-space);
+}
+
+.pavol-eyebrow {
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.75rem;
+    color: var(--pavol-accent);
+    font-size: 0.6875rem;
+    font-weight: 600;
+    line-height: 1.7;
+    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
+    text-transform: uppercase;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-title {
+    text-wrap: balance;
+}
+
+.pavol-section-description {
+    color: var(--pavol-muted);
+}
+
+.pavol-hero-name {
+    font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.4vw, 6.5rem);
+    line-height: 1.04;
+    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame {
+    position: relative;
+    isolation: isolate;
+    overflow: hidden;
+    aspect-ratio: 0.93;
+    border-radius: 1.25rem 8rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;
+    background: #e6e8dd;
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-frame::after {
+    position: absolute;
+    inset: 1.25rem;
+    z-index: -1;
+    border: 1px solid rgb(32 57 50 / 12%);
+    border-radius: 0.25rem 6.75rem 0.25rem 0.25rem;
+    content: '';
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-disc {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 10%;
+    left: 4%;
+    width: 92%;
+    aspect-ratio: 1;
+    border-radius: 50%;
+    background: var(--pavol-gold);
+}
+
+.pavol-portrait-image {
+    position: absolute;
+    top: 5%;
+    left: 7%;
+    width: 86%;
+    height: auto;
+    max-width: none;
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button {
+    background: var(--pavol-ink);
+    color: white;
+    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(32 57 50 / 8%);
+}
+
+.pavol-primary-button:hover {

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { pavolNumbers as PAVOL_NUMBERS } from '@/businesses/pavol/config-numbers';
+import { PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME } from '@/businesses/pavol/layout';
+import { PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT } from '@/businesses/pavol/pavolContent';
+import type { SupportedHomepageLanguage } from '@/lib/homepage-language';
+
+export function PavolNumbersSection({ language }: { readonly language: SupportedHomepageLanguage }) {
+    const CONTENT = PAVOL_PAGE_CONTENT[language].numbers;
+
+    return (
+        <section id="numbers" tabIndex={-1} className="pb-16 outline-none sm:pb-24">
+            <div className={PAVOL_CONTAINER_CLASS_NAME}>
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[var(--pavol-ink)]/20 pt-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-10">
+                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium tracking-tight">{CONTENT.title}</h2>
+                    <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)]">{CONTENT.description}</p>
+                </div>
+                <dl className="pavol-numbers mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-8 lg:grid-cols-4">
+                    {PAVOL_NUMBERS[language].map((ITEM) => (
+                        <div key={ITEM.label} className="flex flex-col">
+                            <dt className="mt-3 max-w-[15rem] text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--pavol-muted)] sm:text-sm">
+                                {ITEM.label}
+                            </dt>
+                            <dd className="order-first font-[family-name:var(--font-outfit)] text-5xl font-medium tracking-[-0.05em] text-[var(--pavol-accent)] sm:text-6xl">
+                                {ITEM.value}
+                            </dd>
+                        </div>
+                    ))}
+                </dl>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    );
+}
